command.name: Tail Whip
verbatim: Odd-numbered Rounds: Deal Physical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +100%).
At 6+ Stars: Even-numbered Rounds: Deal Physical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +70%). 35% chance to afflict Bleed for 2 round(s) (Damage Rate: +20%).

vanguard.name: Warrior's Zeal
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase your Physical Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Battle Rush
habits.verbatim: At the start of round 1, increase your Initiative by +35% and reduce Instinct by -21% (enhanced by Strength) of 2 Enemies within adjacency. Each effect lasts for 3 rounds.

habits.name: Dragon's Might
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Physical Damage (Active Commands and Habits) Dealt by +11.2% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Barbed Lash
habits.verbatim: Tail Whip gains: Even-numbered Rounds: Deal Physical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +70%). Additionally, there is a 35% chance to afflict the target with Bleed for 2 round(s) (Damage Rate: +20%). Bleed deals Physical Damage to the target each round.

habits.name: Armor Break
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase the Physical Damage Received by +5.67% of 1 opposing Enemy until the end of combat.

habits.name: Staggering Assault
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 10% to afflict Stagger on 1 Enemy in the same lane for 1 round(s). The duration is doubled (2 rounds) if you have Advantage.
